evidence.decision: Selects vision/hearing/mobility/time branches against a complete task, rather than asserting every screenshot proves semantics or preference support.
evidence.artifact: Requires a revised interface or evidence-grounded barrier/change/check review and prioritizes task blockers.
evidence.transformation: Astronomy log replaces red/green-only quality, save chime and gesture-only Delete with explicit status, visible saved state and labelled action.
evidence.verification: Explicitly fails loss at text scale, single-sense information, inaccessible essential actions and preference behavior; names appropriate native tools while preserving execution limits.
evidence.applicability: Preserves 200% versus watch 140%, table-specific contrast scope, control defaults versus minima, Assistive Access-only two confirmations and visionOS head-lock prohibition.
evidence.handoffs: VoiceOver, typography, motion and spatial-layout links are conditional on the barrier and preserve the task acceptance checks.
evidence.distinctiveness: Multi-sensory equivalence, assistive task tracing and evidence limits are detailed accessibility decisions with a worked change rather than interchangeable article prose.
